1. [FACT] User is planning to volunteer at a local food bank.

4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the most out of the food bank volunteering experience.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips include being prepared to work hard, dressing appropriately, arriving on time, following instructions, being respectful and empathetic, taking initiative, working as a team, being mindful of food safety, taking breaks, and reflecting on the experience.
6. [PREFERENCE] User is interested in getting more involved in the community.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several ways to find volunteer opportunities in the area, including using VolunteerMatch.org, researching local non-profits, checking community centers, following local organizations on social media, visiting United Way's website, and asking for word-of-mouth recommendations.

14. [PREFERENCE] User is interested in organizations that provide food and shelter services.
15. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed common volunteer roles in demand at organizations providing food and shelter services, including meal service volunteers, food sorting and packing volunteers, shelter assistants, donation sorting volunteers, event volunteers, and administrative volunteers.
16. [PREFERENCE] User wants to know more about the organization's mission, values, and goals when inquiring about volunteer opportunities.
